note: Planning figures. Every row says whether it is a measurement or an estimate; costs_from_aws.py replaces the compute, transfer and storage rows with Cost Explorer numbers once cycles run.

stripe.note: Assumed standard US card rate; confirm against the Stripe account before launch.

monthly.basis: One m8g.8xlarge Spot instance for about 5.0 h per cycle at about $0.52 an hour (measured on the tm06 acceptance run), 60 cycles a month
Lambda renders measured on a laptop (about 3 s of work per forecast hour); roughly $0.03-0.05 per cycle for all regions
About 2-3 GB per cycle copied from AWS to the grid host at $0.09 per GB; downloads from the grid host carry no egress fee
About 150 GB for a 30-day archive on the grid host at $0.015 per GB-month, plus pennies for the 7-day map frames

startup.stage: Phase 0: build the model on AWS and run one historical cycle

startup.note: Phase 1 as a whole is planned at under $50

startup_scope: Cloud compute and transfer for the build and early cases. Storage for the build and the early cases is not included.
engineering_time: Engineering time is not billed and is not in any figure on this page. It is the larger cost.
engineering_time_decision: Joe to state the real engineering time in words before launch
